effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and 1 blue Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended, gain 1 memory.
